text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen—a momentous race
where the
best of the best come
together...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There, Марузенски shows the world a
run that fills
other athletes with
inspiration and motivation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After such a fulfilling race, she believes
that she'll
continue to enjoy running
from here on out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
